item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I found no strong 2024 source showing Sharif affirmatively committed to keeping elections fully free, fair, and meaningfully contestable or to insulating courts/media/election administration from political advantage. The positive evidence is procedural and limited; the balance of the record points the other way.","evidence":[{"title":"Shehbaz Sharif to be coalition candidate for next Pakistan PM -spokeswoman","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/shehbaz-sharif-to-be-coalition-candidate-for-next-pakistan-pm-spokeswoman/1965379/","summary":"After a hung parliament, Sharif’s route back to office depended on coalition bargaining, which is the main pro-contestability fact in the record; it shows power was still negotiated rather than automatically inherited.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Shehbaz Sharif elected Pakistan’s prime minister for second term","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-03","url":"https://theprint.in/india/shehbaz-sharif-elected-pakistans-prime-minister-for-second-term/1986782/","summary":"Parliament formally elected Sharif, so the transfer of power remained procedurally contestable; however, the result was immediately disputed by opponents as rigged, so this is only weak positive evidence.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Pakistan’s Imran Khan’s party loses cricket bat electoral symbol","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/pakistans-imran-khans-party-loses-cricket-bat-electoral-symbol/1923216/","summary":"Pakistan’s Supreme Court upheld the Election Commission’s removal of PTI’s bat symbol on technical intra-party-election grounds, which was a legally framed but materially disadvantageous electoral-rule change for Sharif’s main opponent.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"US, UK and EU urge probe into Pakistan election, express concerns","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-10","url":"https://www.theprint.in/world/us-uk-eu-urge-probe-into-pakistan-election-express-concerns/1961577/","summary":"Major external partners publicly cited concerns about irregularities, interference, and fraud and urged a probe, which is strong counterevidence that the election environment was clean or fully contestable.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"US concerned about reports of intimidation, voter suppression in Pakistan election, White House says","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-15","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/us-concerned-about-reports-of-intimidation-voter-suppression-in-pakistan-election-white-house-says-3305341","summary":"The White House explicitly raised intimidation and voter-suppression concerns, reinforcing that the electoral contest was not being treated as free and fair.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on people’s rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"Telecommunications and mobile internet were shut down on election day, which Amnesty called a blunt attack on expression and assembly; this is direct evidence of a coercive election environment, though it was carried out by the caretaker setup rather than Sharif’s cabinet.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9","4B.1"]},{"title":"Pakistan: The new Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act threatens the right to protest","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-09","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/pakistan-the-new-peaceful-assembly-and-public-order-act-threatens-the-right-to-protest/","summary":"The government rushed through a new protest law that Amnesty said criminalized peaceful assembly and expanded authority to ban or restrict gatherings, showing entrenchment through legal restriction rather than neutral rule-setting.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Pakistan Government Intensifies Crackdown on Political Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-09","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent","summary":"HRW reported mass arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, and mobile-internet cuts against PTI protesters, including peaceful demonstrators, which is strong evidence of using security forces and public controls to suppress opponents.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Pakistan’s government curbs judiciary’s power after alleged harassment of MPs","publisher":"The Guardian","date":"2024-10-21","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps","summary":"The 26th Amendment changed senior-judge appointment rules in a way critics said weakened judicial independence, and it passed amid allegations of intimidation and abductions of MPs; this is direct evidence against refraining from court manipulation.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Urgent and transparent investigation needed into deadly crackdown on opposition protesters","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-27","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/urgent-and-transparent-investigation-needed-into-deadly-crackdown-on-opposition-protesters/","summary":"Amnesty described deaths, mass detentions, shutdowns, and a pattern of intolerance for peaceful protest during the Islamabad crackdown, which is the clearest year-end evidence that the government was not simply leaving political competition open.","question_ids":["4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]}]}
